description:
We are seeking a Director of Software Engineering to lead the Consumer Portal portfolio. This leader brings strong technical depth and architectural judgment, combined with solid managerial skill and a steady focus on customer outcomes. You will go deep on technology and architecture, lead and grow a team of 40 people, and keep customer needs at the center of every major decision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the technical strategy and architecture for the Consumer Portal portfolio, spanning multiple teams and product areas.

  • Go deep on technology and architecture. Make critical decisions on system design, technology choices, and trade-offs at scale.

  • Lead, manage, and grow a team of 40 people, including hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management.

  • Mentor and develop Staff and Senior engineers, building a pipeline of future technical leaders.

  • Partner with engineering leadership to align the Consumer Portal technology direction with business objectives.

  • Keep customer needs at the center of prioritization, roadmap, and delivery decisions by working closely with product, support, and customer-facing teams.

  • Drive adoption of engineering standards, patterns, and practices for quality, reliability, performance, security, and accessibility across the portfolio, including the effective use of AI tooling in daily engineering work.

  • Lead the diagnosis and resolution of complex, customer-impacting system issues, ensuring stability and performance across environments.

  • Represent the Consumer Portal portfolio in architecture reviews and cross-organization technical forums.

  • Own delivery outcomes for the portfolio, balancing speed, quality, and long-term sustainability.

  • Raise the AI fluency of the team and set standards for responsible, effective use of AI tooling, including the guardrails appropriate to a regulated industry.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM field or equivalent experience.

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record of technical leadership across multiple teams or product areas.

  • Proven experience leading large engineering organizations, including hiring, developing, and retaining talent.

  • Deep expertise in designing and operating distributed, enterprise-scale systems, with a strong grasp of system design, architecture, and trade-offs.

  • Strong systems-thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reason through complex architectural trade-offs at scale.

  • Demonstrated customer focus, including translating customer needs into technical direction and priorities.

  • Excellent communication skills that bridge deeply technical topics and executive-level strategy.

  • Experience driving technical transformation and adoption of engineering standards across a large organization.

  • Experience with application and system performance monitoring, and with troubleshooting complex customer-facing issues.

  • AI fluency, with hands-on use of AI tooling in daily work. Our engineers work with Claude and Claude Code for coding, code review, and analysis, and with Microsoft 365 Copilot for documentation and collaboration.

  • Hands-on familiarity with the current technology environment, including Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security, microservices, Azure, Angular, Docker, and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling such as Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and Terraform.

  • Knowledge of non-relational data stores (e.g., Redis, Elasticsearch) and distributed systems design.

  • Experience leading an engineering organization through a major platform or architecture transformation.

  • Experience leading AI adoption or enablement across an engineering organization, including standards for responsible use.

  • External technical leadership, such as publications, speaking engagements, or standards participation.

Leadership Expectations

This role is measured by the outcomes of the teams it leads. Success means strong technical direction for the Consumer Portal portfolio, a healthy and growing team, and customers who see the impact of every major decision

Director of Software Engineering – Consumer Portal

MeridianLink is seeking a visionary and technically adept Director of Software Engineering to lead our Consumer Portal portfolio. This influential leadership role requires deep technical expertise, architectural acumen, and proven people management abilities, all paired with an unwavering commitment to delivering exceptional customer value. You will drive technology strategy, shape architectural direction, and develop a high-performing team of 40, ensuring customer needs remain central to every decision.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the technical strategy and architecture for the Consumer Portal portfolio, spanning multiple teams and product areas.

  • Dive deep into technology and system architecture, making critical decisions on system design, technology stack, and trade-offs at scale.

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 40 engineers, overseeing hiring, coaching, career progression, and performance management.

  • Guide and develop Staff and Senior Engineers, building a robust pipeline of future technical leaders.

  • Collaborate with engineering leadership to align the Consumer Portal’s technology vision with business objectives.

  • Advocate relentlessly for customer needs, ensuring they are prioritized in roadmaps, delivery, and major decisions by partnering with product, support, and customer-facing teams.

  • Champion the adoption of engineering standards and best practices for quality, reliability, performance, security, and accessibility across the portfolio, including effective use of AI tooling in everyday engineering work.

  • Lead the resolution of complex, customer-impacting issues, maintaining stability and performance across production environments.

  • Represent the Consumer Portal portfolio in architecture reviews and cross-functional technical forums.

  • Own delivery outcomes—balancing speed, quality, and long-term sustainability.

  • Elevate team AI fluency, and set standards for the responsible, effective use of AI tools in a regulated industry.

 

Qualifications

Required:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field or equivalent professional experience.

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience with a record of technical leadership across multiple teams or product areas.

  • Demonstrated success leading large engineering organizations, including recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.

  • Deep experience in designing and operating distributed, enterprise-scale systems with a strong grasp of system architecture and trade-offs.

  • Advanced problem-solving and systems-thinking skills, able to analyze and navigate complex technical challenges at scale.

  • Demonstrated customer focus, translating needs into technical roadmaps and solutions.

  • Excellent communication skills, able to bridge deeply technical topics with executive-level discussions.

  • Experience driving technical transformation and standardization across sizable organizations.

  • Expertise in application/system performance monitoring and advanced troubleshooting of complex, customer-facing platforms.

  • AI fluency, with hands-on usage of AI tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code for coding and analysis, Microsoft 365 Copilot for documentation and collaboration).

  • Hands-on experience with technologies including Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security, microservices, Azure, Angular, Docker, and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with CI/CD and DevOps tools such as Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and Terraform.

  • Knowledge of non-relational data stores (e.g., Redis, Elasticsearch) and distributed systems design.

  • Success in leading organizations through major platform or architectural transformations.

  • Experience driving the adoption and governance of AI usage in engineering teams.

  • Evidence of external technical leadership (publications, speaking engagements, participation in standards bodies).

 

Leadership Expectations

This role’s success is measured by the achievements of the teams you lead. Excellence is defined by delivering clear technical direction for the Consumer Portal portfolio, fostering a thriving and capable team, and ensuring customers experience real impact from every major decision.
